issues.spec_citation: CQL Reference v1.5.3 Appendix B, Duration operator; example `months between @2012-01-02 and @2012 // [0, 10]`.
issues.evidence: Fresh probe showed Python fallback, native-loaded, and no-Python C++ `cqlDurationBetween('2012-01-02', '2012', 'month')` returned `{ "start":0, "end":11 }` while corresponding `cqlDifferenceBetween` correctly returned `{ "start":0, "end":11 }`.
issues.root_cause: Duration uncertainty max used the full high boundary of the imprecise end operand, which can count a finer unspecified partial calendar period as a whole duration period. Difference can use full high boundary because it counts crossed boundaries.
issues.resolution: Added precision-capped duration high-boundary helpers in Python and C++ and used them only for `cqlDurationBetween` max uncertainty; preserved `cqlDifferenceBetween` full-boundary behavior. Rebuilt and copied the bundled CQL DuckDB extension.
issues.verified_in: Iteration 1: `.temp/qa/cql13_skeptic_probe.py`; datetime part1 + wasm C++ parity 16/16; official datetime parser subset 246/246; full conformance 2822/2822.
